description: While a turn is running, decide a permission request DSH is waiting on (these only appear when the conversation uses on_approval=ask); after you allow or deny, the turn continues. It hands DSH's out-of-sandbox and escalation requests to the caller instead of allowing or denying them all. To grade the result of a finished turn use dsh_review.

approval_id.description: From dsh_inbox, or pending_approvals in dsh_get.

conversation_id.description: Conversation id, from dsh_start or dsh_list.
